name: Azure DevOps
sku: Azure DevOps Services: Azure Repos and Azure Pipelines. Free for up to five users, and private projects get one free parallel pipeline job of up to 60 minutes and 1,800 minutes a month. Azure Boards, Test Plans, Artifacts and Azure DevOps Server are not scored.

orchestrate.ci-cd.note: Azure Pipelines combines continuous integration, testing and delivery to build, test and deploy code to any destination, with release approvals and deployment gates, on hosted or self-hosted agents. It deploys to Azure, AWS, Google Cloud or on-premises, and works with source in GitHub or Azure Repos.

orchestrate.event-triggers.note: Builds trigger automatically on code commits. They react to changes in code, not to data arriving.

bands.note: Multi-environment deployment across development, staging and production, with approval workflows and release gates before a build is promoted.

Azure Repos branch policies and approval policies gate what reaches the main branch, and Microsoft Entra ID handles sign-in. It governs who can change code and pipeline definitions, not who can read data.

proposed_capabilities.name: Version control and change review
proposed_capabilities.description: Keeping every change to code and pipeline definitions in history, proposed as a pull request, reviewed under branch policies, and merged only when they pass. It is the base that CI/CD, environments and rollbacks stand on, and no capability in the taxonomy describes it.

proposed_capabilities.name: AI assistance for building and operating pipelines
proposed_capabilities.description: An assistant that can list pipelines, read run history, find failed builds and compare runs in natural language through a Model Context Protocol server, instead of a person clicking through the console.

presentation.tagline: Git repositories and CI/CD pipelines that deploy to Azure, AWS, Google Cloud or on-premises.
